# Vivah

> Wedding-services orchestration marketplace for Nepal: one Expo (SDK 57) React Native app with four role apps (couple, vendor, freelancer, platform staff), an on-device demo backend (zustand) and a Supabase/Postgres production backend (SQL migrations, RPCs, Edge Functions). NPR, 13% VAT, English and Nepali, Bikram Sambat dates.

Read AGENTS.md first: it holds the binding rules (never break existing functionality, Expo Go only, store actions as the API, money invariants, git workflow). If documents disagree, AGENTS.md wins, then the code, then the handbook.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): binding rules for AI agents and people
- [Handbook index](docs/handbook/README.md): how the docs are organised and the reading order
- [Rules and regulations](docs/handbook/00-rules-and-regulations.md): every rule with an id and a reason
- [AI agents guide](docs/handbook/16-ai-agents-guide.md): how to load context, change code and leave docs behind
